extraction: Sure! I read the survey report. It was prepared by Lucia Romero, the Customer Insights Lead at Vantage Telecom, and published on October 6, 2025. They surveyed 4,812 customers and satisfaction went up to 78%. I hope this helps!

summarization.headline: Vantage Telecom's Q3 2025 customer satisfaction rose to 78%, but phone support remains the weakest channel.

key_findings: Mobile app 83%, retail stores 79%, phone support 69% satisfied

Users of the new billing page were more satisfied
recommendations: Add call-back scheduling to phone support
Promote the new billing page in the mobile app
